subject: Request: CIO intro + sponsor presence for pilot demo
messages:
From: Evelyn Rogers <evelyn.rogers@orionbank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@orionbank.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot discussion follow-up — exec presence

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — the tech looks promising. My CIO, Laila Ahmed, wants a very short executive-level view focused on risk, compliance, and how Redwood would fit into our procurement cadence before we commit a pilot. Can we set aside 30–45 minutes next week with Laila and her EA (copied) in attendance, plus whoever from your side can speak to production guarantees (SLA/backups)?

High-level asks from Laila:
- One-slide summary on data flow and controls
- Where audit logs and retention live (we'll need SOC-related notes)
- Rough latency and failover story for a dedicated deployment

We prefer mornings ET if possible. Tom will coordinate calendars.

Best,
Evelyn Rogers
VP, Digital Channels
Orion Bank

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Rogers <evelyn.rogers@orionbank.com>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@orionbank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 14:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pilot discussion follow-up — exec presence

Evelyn — thanks for the note and the clarity on Laila's priorities. Happy to arrange a 45-minute session that covers risk/compliance + SLA posture. Marissa (cc) is our head of customer success and can cover runbooks and SLA commitments; if we need a short product-level assurance, I can ask Vivek to join or have one of our solutions engineers on standby.

Proposed slots (ET mornings):
- Wed 3 Nov, 9:00–9:45am ET
- Thu 4 Nov, 10:00–10:45am ET
- Mon 8 Nov, 9:30–10:15am ET

I attached a one-pager and a draft exec agenda to give Laila a quick read ahead. If those slots don't work, share Tom's availability and we'll flex. Also happy to tighten to 30 minutes and prioritize the compliance bullets.

Attachments: pilot-one-pager.pdf, exec-briefing-agenda.docx

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Aditya — thanks. Laila is traveling on the 3rd and 4th; Monday 8th looks promising but she has a standing leadership readout at 9:30 ET. I can free her for a 45-minute block earlier in the week if you can do Mon 8 at 8:30–9:15am ET, or Tue 9 at 10:30–11:15am ET.

If you need a single backup attendee from Redwood at the VP level, please indicate who that is; Laila prefers a senior sponsor rather than an engineer for the executive portion.

Tom Baxter

Orion Bank

If that time works, can you confirm and we'll send a calendar invite with the short agenda attached. Also copying a single-sheet compliance note in case Laila wants a quick read before the call.
